brand_guidelines.mission: Empowering human physical potential through biomechanical sportswear
banned_elements: No smiling stock models holding thumbs up
No neon rainbow gradients (only cyan and charcoal)

approved_past_work.visual_style_description: Moody, overcast athletic trail running, sharp rim lighting on athlete silhouette, bold cyan text 'DEFIANCE' centered at the top
approved_past_work.headline: DEFIANCE
approved_past_work.copy_snippet: Cold is a condition. Commitment is a choice. #ApexAthletics

approved_past_work.headline: UNBREAKABLE

rejection_history.rejected_element: Bright saturated yellow badge saying '50% OFF'
rejection_history.client_feedback: Looks like a cheap supermarket flyer. We never use bright yellow or tacky discount badges.
rejection_history.corrective_rule: NEVER use yellow, red discount badges, or cliparts. Discounts must be styled in sleek cyan and charcoal typography.

rejection_history.rejected_element: AI generated hand with 6 fingers holding water bottle
rejection_history.client_feedback: Obvious AI distortion in hands, embarrassing to post.
rejection_history.corrective_rule: Vision QA must flag any hand/finger deformities or blurred text before client preview.
